title: Prime extension to multivariate power series
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], d a natural number, and p a prime ideal of A. Then p extended along the constants inclusion C into A[[X_1,...,X_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] is prime.

source.place: Tag 0EY9, associated-prime injectivity detail; coefficientwise quotient expansion of Tag 0312

proof.text: Define the coefficientwise quotient map to power series over A/p. Its target is a domain. For a series in its kernel all coefficients lie in p. Choose a finite generating set of p and induct on the set: express each coefficient as b*a+c for the last generator a, choose the coefficient functions b and c, and assemble the equality f=C(a)*g+k. The induction puts k in the extended ideal, hence f lies there. Conversely coefficient reduction kills every constant generator, so it kills the extended ideal. Thus the extended ideal is the kernel of a map to a domain and is prime. Includes d=0; the zero ring has no prime p.
